exposure: timing of prophylactic antibiotic (Ceftriaxone 1 gm) administration at cesarean section (30-60 minutes before skin incision vs. after cord clamping)
cohort: The study included 176 patients with singleton, live, term or near term pregnancies who underwent cesarean section.
finding: The timing of prophylactic antibiotic application (preoperative vs. after cord clamping) in cesarean section deliveries does not significantly change maternal infectious morbidity or neonate morbidity rates.
